programme.title: Andromeda: Det, vi ikke kan ændre
programme.desc: Et sort hul slår Dylan ud og sender ham ind i en alternativ virkelighed med kone og barn.

programme.title: Andromeda: Den skønne ukendte
programme.desc: Besætningen redder en af de længe forsvundne grundlæggere af Commonwealth, men opdager, at hun måske er mere besværlig, end hun er værd.

programme.title: Andromeda: Udyrets mave
programme.desc: Et mytologisk rumuhyre forsøger at æde Andromeda.

programme.title: Andromeda: Ridderen, døden og djævelen
programme.desc: Dylan forsøger at befri en flåde af tilfangetagne skibe, men flåden er ikke sikker på, at den ønsker at blive befriet. Deres AI'er frygter, at nye kaptajner vil gøre dem til slaver.

programme.title: Andromeda: Ubesmittet opfattelse
programme.desc: Genitter angriber Tyrs kone og koloni.

programme.title: Andromeda: Tunnelen for enden af lyset
programme.desc: Med halvtreds parter om bord er Dylan vært for underskrivelsen af det nye rigsfællesskabs charter, men opdager snart, at der er ubudne gæster, der har til hensigt at stoppe underskrivelsen.

programme.title: Andromeda: Hvis hjulet er fastgjort
programme.desc: Beka og Tyr bliver overtaget af energien fra en dimensionstunnel. Dylan, Trance og Harper må redde dem, før de ødelægger skibet.

programme.title: Andromeda: Rimnis skår
programme.desc: Dylan bliver anklaget for mord og skal rense sit navn, mens han finder delene af en vase, der siges at give ejeren "kosmos velsignelser

programme.title: Andromeda: Gal for at blive reddet
programme.desc: Besætningen redder en gruppe flygtninge, men opdager, at de har været udsat for regeringens eksperimenter og er ekstremt ustabile.

programme.title: Andromeda: Cui Bono
programme.desc: Beka's onkel stiller op til et embede i det nye Commonwealth, men et mordforsøg får besætningen til at agere som hans sikkerhed.

programme.title: Andromeda: Det ensomme og jævne sand
programme.desc: Da Andromeda bliver angrebet af pirater i rummet, bliver de reddet af et længe forsvundet rumskib fra Jorden.

programme.title: Andromeda: Krigshundene Slipfighter
programme.desc: Besætningen opdager, at en slyngelplanet, Marduk, har fremstillet masseødelæggelsesvåben.

programme.title: Andromeda: Den spedalskes kys
programme.desc: En lejemorder ved navn Leper er ude efter lederne af det nye Commonwealth.

programme.title: Andromeda: For Whom the Bell Tolls
programme.desc: Andromeda bliver hjemsøgt af et mystisk væsen, der kommer om bord under en solstorm.

programme.title: Andromeda: And Your Heart Will Fly Away
programme.desc: Da en længe savnet kærlighed vender tilbage, forsvinder Tyr fra skibet for at beskytte hende mod en lejemorder.
programme.sub-title: And Your Heart Will Fly Away

programme.title: Andromeda: Den uovervindelige mand
programme.desc: Spiller i et alternativt univers, hvor Dylan er død, og Gaheris Rhade forsøger at reformere Commonwealth.

programme.title: Andromeda: Delenda Est
programme.desc: Den gruppe, der angreb Andromeda under den første underskrivelse af Commonwealth-charter, vender tilbage for at skabe mere ravage.

programme.title: Andromeda: Det mørke bagud
programme.desc: Trance gennemgår nogle forskellige scenarier og forsøger at finde et, hvor hendes besætningsmedlemmer ikke dør.

programme.title: Andromeda: Risiko-alt-punktet
programme.desc: Et kraftigere Andromeda skib eksploderer sandsynligvis på grund af sabotage, hvilket tvinger Dylans besætning til at redde dem.

programme.title: Andromeda: Den rigtige hest
programme.desc: Beka bringer både sin besætning og en hel planet i fare, da en tidligere kærlighed dukker op.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Cold Hearted
programme.desc: When a young fireman died from what appeared to be serious but undiagnosed heart disease, his family and friends had no proof of foul play.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Wheel of Misfortune
programme.desc: Casino security cameras tracked a young woman's movements until shortly before she disappeared. She was never seen again, but through the evidence she left behind, she was able to tell investigators what happened to her and who was responsible.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Quite a Spectacle
programme.desc: It was one of the most unusual cases in forensic history. Investigators had to find a way to solve a murder case using only a squashed tomato found at the crime scene and tiny, pinpoint reflections of light in a photograph.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Transaction Failed
programme.desc: When a dedicated, well-respected teacher disappeared, police had to determine if she'd gone on vacation without telling anyone or if she was the victim of foul play.

programme.title: Forensic Files: The Day the Music Died
programme.desc: Seattle police had no suspects in the violent murder of grunge singer Mia Zapata. More than a decade passed before evidence collected by a prescient medical examiner could be used by forensic scientists to identify the killer.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Sole Survivor
programme.desc: A Michigan State University grad student disappeared and was presumed dead. With the help of a professor of geological sciences, police hoped to get the "dirt" on her killer.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Insignificant Others
programme.desc: How unlucky could one man be? His college sweetheart killed herself and fourteen years later, his wife ended her life in a similar way. Investigators had to determine if this was murder or simply a bizarre coincidence.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Catch 22
programme.desc: In 1996, 54-year-old Gayle Isleib was ambushed in her Manchester, Connecticut driveway and shot to death. Police had to determine whether obsessive love was the motive for her murder.

programme.title: Forensic Files: A Cinderella Story
programme.desc: The victim had been sexually assaulted and stabbed to death on the beach. A pair of men's tennis shoes was discovered near her body. Police were sure that if they found the man who fit the shoes, they would also find the man who committed the crime.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Screen Pass
programme.desc: A 13-year-old girl went missing from her Colorado home. The only evidence the kidnapper left behind was three fingerprints on a window screen.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Pressed for Crime
programme.desc: Several suspects and conflicting evidence complicated a brutal murder investigation. But the forensics were clear on one thing: the killer knew his victim, and that alone gave investigators a head start.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Finger Pane
programme.desc: A serial killer was on the loose and police had to find him before he struck again. Their most promising lead was an unusual one: a bloody fingerprint on the body of one of the victims.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Good as Gold
programme.desc: On Halloween night 2004, Adriane Insogna and Leslie Mazzara were brutally murdered in their Napa, California home.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Freedom Fighter
programme.desc: After the suspect was convicted of arson and murder, he maintained his innocence. He turned to law books in the prison library and set out to prove his innocence.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Dog Day Afternoon
programme.desc: A woman was brutally murdered in her home and the only witnesses to the crime were the family dogs. An expert in canine behavior was convinced the killer knew both the victim and the animals, and he was determined find out what the dogs had seen.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Shattered Innocence
programme.desc: This killer probably hoped to cover his tracks by staging the crime scene. But investigators saw through the attempt almost immediately and turned to forensic science to learn what really happened that night.

programme.title: Forensic Files: All Butt Certain
programme.desc: A 6-year-old girl ran and hid when she saw her grandmother being beaten to death, but the man followed, beat and assaulted her. She said the assailant was her uncle, who was later convicted. She recanted her testimony years later.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Jean Pool
programme.desc: In 1984, the body of college student Laura Salmon was found on a Middle Tennessee farm, covered with her own denim jeans as well as the jeans of the killer.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Traffic Violations
programme.desc: The body of a young woman was found a mile from her abandoned car. Police were especially concerned when they realized the victim had come to them for protection just two weeks earlier after a road rage incident.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Brotherly Love
programme.desc: In 1969, 25-year-old phone operator Diane Maxwell was raped and murdered. Her brother promised he'd find out who was responsible and bring the killer to justice.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Disrobed
programme.desc: The crime scene was especially violent: a husband and wife had been shot to death in their bedroom. Was their 16-year-old daughter complicit?

programme.title: Forensic Files: Driven to Silence
programme.desc: A young hairdresser was sexually assaulted and murdered in her own beauty salon. The evidence at the crime scene didn't match any of the suspects and, after the initial investigation, the case went cold for ten years.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Printed Proof
programme.desc: When two women went missing and were later found brutally murdered, police wondered if they were victims of a hate crime.

programme.title: Forensic Files: About Face
programme.desc: A human skeleton was discovered in the North Carolina marshlands. When investigators learned she'd been dead for 18 months, they knew it would be difficult to find out who she was, let alone who killed her.

programme.title: Forensic Files: In the Bag
programme.desc: After shooting his victims in the head, the killer staged the scene, placed the incriminating evidence into a plastic bag and tossed it into the river.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Yes, In Deed
programme.desc: It was a tragic twist of fate. Just days after a woman sold her home and moved to a modest trailer, a fire took both the trailer and her life. But the autopsy proved this was no accident.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Guarded Secrets
programme.desc: A security guard disappeared from his post without a trace; his remains were found a year later in a remote campsite.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Smoking Out a Killer
programme.desc: A college senior was found raped and murdered near an unpaved footpath used by students to walk from one side of campus to the other.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Frozen Assets
programme.desc: In 2004, Mary Ann Clibbery was found brutally murdered at her Illinois business. Investigators had to determine if this was a robbery gone wrong or a calculated murder.

programme.title: Forensic Files: House Hunting
programme.desc: In 2006, Texas real estate agent Sarah Anne Walker was found brutally murdered in a model home. Weeks later, a witness came forward who may have seen the killer. Police used forensic hypnosis to help him recall every detail of the man's appearance.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Shoot to Thrill
programme.desc: In 2003, St. Cloud teenager Jason MacLennan returned home after a night out with friends and discovered his father's body lying in a pool of blood.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Political Thriller
programme.desc: In 2006, Nevada politician Kathy Augustine died mysteriously during a re-election campaign. The medical examiner could neither isolate the cause of death, nor explain the tiny puncture wounds discovered during the autopsy.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Double Cross
programme.desc: In 1996, Virginia Beach police arrive at the Makdessi apartment to find the bloodied bodies of Elise Makdessi and Navy sailor Quincy Brown. But was Brown Elise's lover or her assailant?

programme.title: Forensic Files: Dancing with the Devil
programme.desc: In 1999, Patrick McRae was found dead in his Des Moines home and the crime scene was awash with blood. Analysis showed it had come from two people, one of whom was female.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Last Dance
programme.desc: In 2000, the body of exotic dancer Rachel Siani was found beneath a New Jersey bridge. Investigators wondered if she had committed suicide. They discovered that Rachel offered to assist a drunk customer named John "Jack" Denofa to his motel room.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Constructive Criticism
programme.desc: In 2000, construction manager Darrell North was found dead in his work trailer in Ft. Worth, Texas. When investigators arrived, they found that he had been stabbed 46 times, indicating a personal relationship between the victim and the attacker.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Home Evasion
programme.desc: In 2000, Judy Southern arrived home from work and was shot by a gunman waiting within. Her husband arrived shortly afterwards, called emergency services and drove her to the hospital.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The World Trade Center Bombing
programme.desc: Terrorist bombings are what happen in other countries. Not here in the United States. And yet, in 1993, it happened in New York City.

programme.title: The FBI Files: John Gotti: Convicted
programme.desc: John Gotti was ambitious, powerful and ruthless. He ruled with flash and conspicuous style, playing celebrity with the media and cat and mouse with the FBI. They called John Gotti the Teflon Don. Serious charges just wouldn't stick.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The True Story of Mississippi Burning
programme.desc: Philadelphia, Mississippi, 1964. A sleepy southern town steeped in tradition finds itself targeted for invasion.
programme.sub-title: The True Story of Mississippi Burning

programme.title: The FBI Files: A Model Killer
programme.desc: It's a model's job to rivet the public's attention. But in 1984, some aspiring models began attracting publicity in a terrible new way.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Hired Gun
programme.desc: When three people were found murdered in their home, it appeared like a burglary gone awry. But a crime this horrific deserved a closer look.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Cat and Mouse
programme.desc: He was a predator, abducting girls and young women from their own front yards in broad daylight. He was a sadist: phoning one victim's family, taunting them, boosting then dashing their hope, and he wouldn't stop until we stopped him.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Cracking The Cartel
programme.desc: A mother and child are kidnapped a bystander is murdered. Violence such as this shattered a quiet Texas neighborhood and exposed a drug cartel that flourished where it was least expected.

programme.title: The FBI Files: A Stranger in Town
programme.desc: She appeared on the highway in the spring, a young woman, her life cut short, her past and her identity a mystery. Only by finding out who she was could we ever hope to find her killer.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Hunter's Game
programme.desc: In the 1970s and 80s, people went to Alaska looking for a fresh start, to reinvent themselves, or to disappear for a while. Some of those disappearances weren't by choice.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Dixie Mafia
programme.desc: On Mississippi's Gulf Coast, a Judge and his politician wife are murdered in their home. The killer left few clues. It looked like a professional hit, and the investigation led nowhere. But the FBI refused to give up.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Shattered Shield
programme.desc: In a city awash in narcotics the drug lords have all the power even over the police. Corruption in New Orleans grew like cancer, eating away at public safety and threatening to destroy the city. Crooked cops break the laws they were sworn to uphold.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Blood Brothers
programme.desc: When the small community of Noel, Missouri discovered their bank was robbed, they're shocked. When the bank president turned up missing, they're outraged. And when clues began to surface the facts were more terrible than anyone could have guessed.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Crime Spree
programme.desc: They swept through six states like a plague, thrill killers acting without rhyme or reason. They targeted adults and young girls, kidnapping, and murdering. And in their rampage, they left plenty of clues, but moving targets are the hardest to hit.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Family Secrets
programme.desc: A woman and her infant son vanish. The husband is frantic. The clues are scarce, but hopes linger, even as the hours and days tick by without a word. Was she on the run, or the victim of foul play?

programme.title: The FBI Files: Master Plan
programme.desc: Willow Springs, Illinois, seemed like any other quiet Midwestern community. But it was really one of the most corrupt places in the nation. This tiny village, nestled just outside of Chicago, was in the hip pocket of organized crime.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Firefight
programme.desc: In Miami, a gang of robbers targeted banks and armored cars. They carried assault weapons and weren't afraid to use them. They struck during the day, and sometimes twice a day. For awhile, they seemed unstoppable.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Killer Abroad
programme.desc: Beginning in 1990, Europe found itself in the clutches of a serial killer. He became an international outlaw, hopping from country to country to evade capture and to kill again.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Moving Target
programme.desc: When a sniper in Utah started targeting African-American men for death, authorities launched a massive investigation. With scant clues and no witnesses they found the odds stacked against them, and they had no idea where the killer would strike next.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Fatal Abduction
programme.desc: Anytime, anywhere, people disappear, kidnapped from their daily routines. Predators always leave clues behind, but chasing them takes time, hampering investigators' attempts to solve these fatal abductions.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Medical Examiners's Casebook
programme.desc: Some killers choose to hide their victims. And investigators must then rely on forensic examiners to uncover proof of murder. These are just two extraordinary crimes that have made their way into the medical examiner's casebook.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Trial By Fire
programme.desc: At a crime scene, anything left behind or seemingly out of place is considered a clue. But a fire can extinguish everything in its path challenging forensic investigators at every turn and making each arson a trial by fire.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Undaunted
programme.desc: Solving crimes may begin with gut intuition, but advanced science provides investigators with irrefutable proof. When criminals go to great lengths to mask their crimes, investigators must step up the challenge and remain forever undaunted.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Forsaken Trust
programme.desc: When victims of murder know their killers, they are often caught off guard. But even the best-laid plans leave traces of the forsaken trust.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Coroner Investigator
programme.desc: CI: Coroner Investigator will reveal the most in-depth look to date into the science of death.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Hidden Obsessions
programme.desc: In San Diego, California, a killer has left behind pieces of evidence. Detectives must sort through these small clues to prove murder.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Blind Trust
programme.desc: A woman's body is found and investigators have little time and few clues to lead them to a killer who could strike again. Perpetrators try to conceal their crimes, yet savvy investigators can take the most obscure data and recreate a murder.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Shattered Vows
programme.desc: A woman is found dead at the bottom of the basement stairs. As detectives look into the accident, they begin to question the sequence of events.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Fatal Impressions
programme.desc: 911 receives a desperate call in Fort Worth, Texas. A man's wife is shot. Forensic investigators search for clues in unlikely places, hoping the victim herself could provide information needed to determine how and why she died.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Misplaced Loyalty
programme.desc: In Northern California, a fire rages in the middle of the night. A woman's charred body is discovered in the smoldering aftermath.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Killing Time
programme.desc: A killer may strike in the middle of the night, and hide clues well. But the police are always there, ready and working, and they will never give up when they're on the trail of criminals who decide it's Killing Time.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Silent Killers
programme.desc: Weeks pass as forensic investigators search for even the smallest clues, only to find what they feared in their own backyard. In Canada, two people die suddenly of unknown causes, and their deaths may not be as coincidental as they first appear.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Out To Kill
programme.desc: An abandoned car outside Philadelphia brings heartbreak to a family and terror to a community. A young woman is dead, the killer gone. But the marks of his passage remain.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Raw Greed
programme.desc: A friendly Midwest lodge becomes the scene of a gruesome double murder. Two men are dead and a safe filled with cash is missing.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Murderous Attraction
programme.desc: In Columbus, Ohio, a woman is found shot in the head. The death is ruled a suicide, but something is not right and detectives refuse to let the matter rest.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Broken Trust
programme.desc: A New York homebuyer gets more than he bargained for when a house inspection turns up a mummified corpse. For decades, the crime had gone undiscovered. The victim unmissed, and the killer unpunished.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Price of Murder
programme.desc: Using science as their most powerful weapon, investigators must find these hired killers and make them pay the true price of murder.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: The Dark Side
programme.desc: In terms of the Universe, we know we don't know much, especially when it comes to dark matter and dark energy. Scientists are devoting so much of their time to discovering as much as the possibly can about this mysterious matter.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: The Gas Giants
programme.desc: In the cold, dark expanse of our solar system, beyond the asteroid belt, lie the giant planets. Some can be seen with the naked eye, others have been visited by our camera. What secrets do they hold?

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: Atmosphere
programme.desc: Our atmosphere is an unbelievably complex machine that protects us from the vacuum of space, shelters us from harmful radiation and allows us and the biosphere to breath; we need to learn much more about it so we can better it.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Superscopes
programme.desc: The human eye can only see visible light, a small spectrum of electromagnetic waves. Today, we have instruments that let us perceive all wavelengths.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Night Fire
programme.desc: The Northern Lights are more than just beautiful; they tell us about the make up of our planet, our sun, and may even be a signpost for the possibility of life on other planets.

programme.title: Trajectory - Milestones in Space Exploration: The Space Race, The Hubble, Chasing Comets & Space Debris
programme.desc: Cold War & The Start of the Space Race - Cold War rivalry and the acceleration of space exploration. Servicing Hubble - Preparations for Hubble's final servicing mission. Chasing a Comet - Launch and the difficult path to rendezvous.
programme.sub-title: The Space Race, The Hubble, Chasing Comets & Space Debris

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: Stars Above
programme.desc: The life cycle of stars reveal to us the past and the future of Earth and ourselves.

programme.title: The Apollo Experience: Apollo 17: Part 1
programme.desc: Between 1960 and 1972, mankind boldly went where no human had been before. Across 11 manned missions, 24 men flew to the moon and 12 walked upon its surface. This film documents Apollo 17 through the eyes of the astronauts who flew.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Cosmic Rays
programme.desc: Cosmic rays can tell us much about the universe. They are not simply another form of light, but carriers of information about powerful and unseen processes at work thousands or even millions of light years away.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: Exo Planets
programme.desc: As scientists and astronomers peer more closely and with evermore fidelity at nearby stars, they are discovering countless exo planets. How many Earth-like planets are out there? Could one of them hold life not so different from our own?

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: First Light
programme.desc: The Hubble Telescope is nearing its end, the replacements are ready to go, ready to peer further back in time and space than can be imagined.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: Invasion Mars
programme.desc: For over 50 years we have bombarded Mars with our probes and landers. Spying from orbit to map terrain, finding her strengths and weaknesses. The time nearing for the full scale invasion of the planet, when humans walk on Mars and claim it for their own.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Gravity
programme.desc: Gravity has long been a force that has intrigued scientists. Now, for the first time scientists are probing to detect gravity waves in space as well as mapping the gravity patterns of the moon.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: The Giant Planets: Lords of Gravity / Outer Limits: Edge of the Solar System
programme.desc: See the sun, moon, planets, and galaxies through the eyes of intrepid machines that are blazing a trail across the solar system. A gateway to bold adventures, these cameras are delivering spectacular new cosmic vistas.
programme.sub-title: The Giant Planets: Lords of Gravity / Outer Limits: Edge of the Solar System

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Seasons of Saturn
programme.desc: Saturn is the second largest planet and has an astonishing 60 moons in its orbit. Thanks to the Cassini mission, it's also one of the most studied and most photographed planets in our neighborhood.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: Return to the Moon
programme.desc: The moon is our closest celestial companion. It lights our night sky and gently tugs at our shores. Few have walked on her surface, but her allure remains strong.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: Space: Getting There
programme.desc: The new surge in space transportation, privately owned companies vying for government contracts and private entrepreneurs looking to build hotels in space.

programme.title: Trajectory - Milestones in Space Exploration: Project Mercury, The Mars Express & The Soyuz Launch System
programme.desc: Project Mercury Begins - The start of NASA & America's first manned space program. Mars Express - The European Space Agency's Mars Satellite. The Soyuz Launch System - The gradual evolution of Russia's Soyuz launcher.
programme.sub-title: Project Mercury, The Mars Express & The Soyuz Launch System

programme.title: Trajectory - Milestones in Space Exploration: The Shuttle Program, The Challenger Disaster & Return to Space
programme.desc: The Shuttle Program - The first re-useable spacecraft. The Challenger Disaster - Pressing launch schedules lead to carelessness and the loss of the Challenger. Return to Space - A re-designed shuttle is back in space with a redefined role.
programme.sub-title: The Shuttle Program, The Challenger Disaster & Return to Space

programme.title: Trajectory - Milestones in Space Exploration: The Apollo Program Begins, Caves & Planck
programme.desc: The Apollo Program Begins - At the very beginning of NASA's moon project things go wrong. Caves - ESA's special training program for astronauts. Planck - Mapping the cosmic microwave background radiation.
programme.sub-title: The Apollo Program Begins, Caves & Planck

programme.title: Trajectory - Milestones in Space Exploration: Rebuilding Apollo, Orbiting Carbon & Zero Gravity Training
programme.desc: Rebuilding Project Apollo - After the Apollo 1 disaster NASA resumes manned space flight. Orbiting Carbon Observatory 2 - Monitoring the Earth's Co2 levels in unprecedented detail. Zero Gravity Training - Parabolic flights.
programme.sub-title: Rebuilding Apollo, Orbiting Carbon & Zero Gravity Training

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Landsat
programme.desc: Take a look at Landsat 8, the advanced planetary explorer with a 900 million dollar price tag! It is designed to peer across multiple wavelengths to reveal complex and ever-changing details that are undetectable by the human eye.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Milky Way
programme.desc: This episode traces our view of the Milky Way, from the mythology of ancient sky watchers to the efforts of scientists to map it from the inside out.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: From There to Here
programme.desc: The sky above is studded with stars and countless galaxies. In them, we can read not only our origin, but also our final destination. Technology is on the brink of taking us to places we have only dreamed of.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: The Moons of Olympus
programme.desc: There are many more worlds in our solar system than just the planets. The mysterious moons of the gas giants may hold much more than we ever imagined. Each one is unique, and each one deserves a scrutinous eye.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: Shore to Shore
programme.desc: With low Earth orbit delegated to private companies, NASA is free to develop the deep space hardware for missions to Mars and beyond. The Orion space craft and SLS launch system are well on their way to delivering this capability.

programme.title: In the Shadow of the Moon
programme.desc: Between 1968 and 1972, the world watched in awe each time an American spacecraft voyaged to the Moon. Only 12 men walked upon its surface and they remain the only human beings to have stood on another world.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Hubble's Renaissance
programme.desc: Before we can reach space, we must first be able to see it. Hundreds of years ago, the simple telescope was used to give us a seemingly closer vantage. Today, we use the awe-inspiring, and super powerful, Hubble Space Telescope.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Vesta Unveiled
programme.desc: With the Dawn missions exploration of the asteroid Vesta and the dwarf planet Ceres, asteroids are a hot topic. See what these incredible missions have uncovered.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Science and the Shuttle
programme.desc: For more than 25 years the shuttle was our ticket to space, and our laboratory in orbit. Uncover the legacy of this amazing machine, and see what lies ahead.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: The Hot Zone
programme.desc: Mercury is one Earth's closest neighbors, but for centuries it eluded astronomer's best efforts to learn its secrets. But that has changed thanks to missions like Mariner and most recently, Messenger.

programme.title: Trajectory - Milestones in Space Exploration: The Space Shuttle Matures, Complex Space Construction & The Final Years of the Space Shuttle
programme.desc: The Space Shuttle Matures - The Space Transportation System changes the nature of orbital missions. Complex Construction in Space - Confidence in the shuttle begins to return and engineers for get the lessons of the past.
programme.sub-title: The Space Shuttle Matures, Complex Space Construction & The Final Years of the Space Shuttle

programme.title: The Mystery of Dark Matter
programme.desc: Dark matter, which is unknown and undetectable in our physical models, would appear to populate the cosmos on a massive scale. For the first time, a film portrays the wild scientific quest that dark matter gives rise to - a real thriller!

programme.title: The Hills: Forgive and Forget
programme.desc: Heidi og Lauren skændes endnu engang offentligt, hvilket får Heidi til at undskylde for alt det, der er sket. Og der er problemer i Audrina og Justins forhold.

programme.title: The Hills: With This Ring...
programme.desc: Lauren leger Kirsten Giftekniv, da Whitney skal ud på sin første date med deres personlige træner. Og Spencer modsætter sig Heidis ønsker om et eventyrbryllup.

programme.title: The Hills: A Night At The Opera
programme.desc: Audrina ser Justin kysse med en anden pige, hvilket fører til endnu et kæmpeskænderi. Heidi er chokeret, da Stephanie skændes med Lauren og Brody på en natklub.

programme.title: The Hills: Once a Player
programme.desc: Lauren tror, at Brody måske er for meget playboy for hende. Spencers søster fortæller hende, at Heidi er i tvivl om deres bryllup.

programme.title: The Hills: When One Door Closes...
programme.desc: Lauren får en god nyhed til Teen Vogue og Heidi har brug for noget tid væk fra Spencer.

programme.title: The Hills: Paris Changes Everything
programme.desc: Lauren kommer endelig af sted til Paris, men turen bliver næsten ødelagt da hun finder ud af, at Brody har fundet en anden. Spencer følger Heidi til Colorado for at prøve at vinde hende tilbage, men hans plan slår fejl.

programme.title: The Hills: Back to L.A.
programme.desc: Whitney må vælge mellem Teen Vogue og risikoen forbundet med at gå efter en ny karriere. Lauren og Brody skændes over hans nye kæreste og Heidi vænner sig til livet uden Spencer.

programme.title: The Hills: An Unexpected Friend
programme.desc: Lauren får en uventet ven, da Spencers søster, Stephanie, går til de samme timer som hende. Whitney tror, at hendes nye job vil opfylde alle hendes drømme.

programme.title: The Hills: When Spencer Finds Out...
programme.desc: Da Lauren inviterer Stephanie til hendes fødselsdag, får det Heidi og Spencer til at tvivle på Stephanies loyalitet. Spencer forsøger at vinde Heidi tilbage.

programme.title: The Hills: Just Be Careful...
programme.desc: Heidi prøver at vinde Audrinas venskab tilbage, men Lauren tvivler på Heidis motiver. Whitney er ved at vænne sig til sit nye job, men savner stadig at arbejde sammen med Lauren.

programme.title: The Hills: Girls' Night Out
programme.desc: Heidi elsker at være single, men da hun ser Spencer sammen med andre piger bliver hun jaloux. Whitney beder om Laurens hjælp til modeugen i LA.

programme.title: The Hills: A New Roommate
programme.desc: Med Spencer ude af billedet, gør Heidi et sidste forsøg på at blive gode venner med Lauren igen. Da Audrina begynder at tilbringe mere tid med Heidi og Justin, overvejer Lauren, om de bør blive ved med at bo sammen.

programme.title: The Hills: A Date With The Past
programme.desc: Gammel kærlighed blusser op da Stephen Coletti dukker op i Laurens liv igen. Heidi prøver at sørge for, at Stephanie ikke kommer til Laurens housewarming.

programme.title: The Hills: No Place Like Home
programme.desc: Lauren har svært ved at vælge side, da problemerne mellem Lo og Audrina eskalerer. Og Heidi tager et job, der vil tage hende til Las Vegas.

programme.title: The Hills: The Next Move Is Yours
programme.desc: I sæsonens sidste afsnit føler Audrina sig lukket ude af Laurens venskab med Lo, og hun overvejer at flytte ud. Lauren gør et sidste forsøg på at blive god venner med Audrina, men måske er det for sent.

programme.title: The Hills: We'll Never Be Friends
programme.desc: Da sæson fire starter er situationen mellem Audrina og Lo anspændt. Lauren forsøger at gøre et godt indtryk på en ny fyr, og et besøg fra Heidis søster Holly truer Spencer og Heidis forhold.

programme.title: The Hills: Drama Follows Them
programme.desc: Stephanie bliver uvenner med sin bror og hans ven da Lauren møder Spencer på sin fødselsdag. Kelly Cutrone fyrer en fra People's Revolution og Whitney overtager stillingen. Laurens forhold til Doug udvikler sig lidt for hurtigt.

programme.title: The Hills: Better Off As Friends
programme.desc: Lauren indser at den kemi, hun havde med Doug på studiet ikke længere er der. Whitney er nervøs for at tage til New York, men en date med en model gør hende gladere. Til trods for forsoningsgestusen vil Spencer bryde helt med Stephanie.

programme.title: The Hills: Boys Make Girls Cry
programme.desc: En vild tur til Las Vegas går galt, da Audrina ignorerer Lauren. Brody nævner Stephanies fortid, og drengene ryger i brummen. Heidis søster Holly flytter ind, men det er intet Spencer hellere vil end at smide hende ud.

programme.title: The Hills: Something Has To Change
programme.desc: Lauren og Audrina kæmper for at redde deres venskab, men det kan allerede være for sent. Spencer har fået nok af Heidis søster Holly og tager sagen i egne hænder. Og Brody og Doug forlader fængslet med nye historier.

programme.title: The Hills: You Always Miss a Best Friend
programme.desc: Heidis søster Holly tager kontakt med Lauren, noget som tvinger både Lauren og Heidi til at revurdere hvad der er sket med dere venskab.. Audrina og Justins forhold bliver sat på prøve, da hun arbejder på en event for Epic Records.
programme.sub-title: You Always Miss a Best Friend

programme.title: The Hills: When Lauren's Away...
programme.desc: Da Lauren tager på ferie med familien, går alting galt i Los Angeles. Stephanie dater Doug bag Laurens rygg, og Audrina og Heidi bliver venner.

programme.title: The Hills: Don't Act Innocent
programme.desc: Sandheden om Stephanies forhold til Laurens eks Doug kommer frem, da de alle mødes til Dougs poolparty. Heidis mor kommer overraskende på besøg til LA og ryger ud i en konfrontation med Spencer.

programme.title: The Hills: If She Never Met Spencer...
programme.desc: Lauren får et brev fra Heidi, hvor hun beklager og indser, at der kun er én ting, som forhindrer dem i at blive venner igen. Audrina starter med at date en ny fyr for at gøre Justin jaloux, men hendes plan slår fejl.

programme.title: The Hills: Who To Choose?
programme.desc: Audrina møder sin gamle flamme Corey igen og jonglerer pludselig to fyre. Spencer tvinger Heidi til at smide sin søster Holly ud af lejligheden.

programme.title: The Hills: You'll Never Have This
programme.desc: Lauren og Audrina rejser til Cabo til Brody fødselsdag, men da Justin bliver jaloux på Audrinas nye forhold, udvikler festen sig til en slåskamp. Spencer ydmyger Stephanie da hun finder ud af, at hendes nye kæreste er ven med Brody.

programme.title: The Hills: I Want You To Be With Me
programme.desc: Lauren prøver at skabe fred mellem Brody og Stephanie. Audrina vil få tingene til at fungere med Corey, men Justin vil ikke give slip på hende. Stephanie tvivler på sin nye kæreste, da han bryder sit løfte om at konfrontere Brody.
programme.sub-title: I Want You To Be With Me

programme.title: The Hills: It's Her Move
programme.desc: Audrina får sit eget sted, og håber, at Justin vil flytte ind hos hende, men alle frygter, at hun flytter af den forkerte grund. Heidi inviterer Spencer til et arrangement med arbejdet og bliver taget i at have det lidt for sjovt.

programme.title: The Hills: Back To New York
programme.desc: Whitney tager til New York i forventning om at møde Alex igen, men en ny fyr ved navn Jay fanger hendes opmærksomhed. Heidi er ulykkelig efter fyringen, men da Spencer taler med Brent for at skaffe hende jobbet tilbage, forværrer han situationen.

programme.title: The Hills: One Last Chance
programme.desc: Lauren lader Heidis søster overnatte. Justin inviterer Audrina med på en romantisk weekend, og Heidis frustration med Spencer vokser, da hun må tigge for at få sit job tilbage.

programme.title: The Hills: You Did This
programme.desc: Audrina tror på et rygte, hun hører: at Lauren har kysset med Justin. I mellemtiden prøver Holly at få Heidi væk fra Spencer.

programme.title: The Hills: It's About Trust
programme.desc: Audrina forsøger at redde sit venskab med Lauren efter at have anklaget hende for at have kysset med Justin. Spencer og Stephanie besøger deres bedstemore, som er træt af, at de skændes.

programme.title: The Hills: Dream Boy, Dream Job
programme.desc: Whitney bliver tilbudt en chance for a score sit drømmejob NYC og håber at se Jay der. Lauren bliver nostalgisk, da hendes forældre sælger huset i Laguna Beach, og Stephanie går til Spencer for at få hjælp med Cameron.

programme.title: The Hills: Mr. & Mrs. Pratt
programme.desc: Spencer og Heidi ignorerer deres bekymrede familier og stikker af til Mexico for at blive gift. Whitney går efter drømmejobbet i New York City, og siger farvel til Lauren og sit liv i Los Angeles.

programme.title: The Hills: I Heidi Take Thee Spencer
programme.desc: Lauren og Heidi mødes og husker, hvorfor de plejede at være venner. Spencer og Heidi er lige blevet gift, da Heidis mor kommer til byen. Justin chokerer Audrina, da han tager hende med til Palm Springs til en overraskelse.

programme.title: The Hills: Don't Cry On Your Birthday
programme.desc: Da Heidi kommer uanmeldt til Laurens fødselsdagsfest, græder de to gamle venner over deres ødelagte venskab. Spencer kommer op at slås, da Cameron beskylder ham for at samle en bartender op.

programme.title: The Hills: Everything Happens for a Reason
programme.desc: Spencers flirtende opførsel får Heidi til at tage hjem til Colorado, hvor hun møder en gammel kæreste. Lauren skælder Stephanie ud for at have inviteret Heidi til festen. Spencer ender en lang stilhed med Brody.

programme.title: The Hills: I'm Done With You
programme.desc: Da Heidi overrasker Spencer på en natklub med bartenderen Stacie, forlanger hun, at de går i parterapi. Lauren risikerer sit rygte, da hun skaffer Stephanie en praktikplads hos People's Revolution.

programme.title: The Hills: Crazy In Love
programme.desc: Audrina prøver at komme sig over Justin ved at gå efter Brody. Heidi slæber en modvillig Spencer med til parterapi. Da Stephanie kvajer sig hos People's Revolution, truer Lauren med at fyre hende.

programme.title: The Hills: I Always Had A Little Crush
programme.desc: Audrina prøver at glemme Justin ved at score Brody, da pigerne tager med på drengenes surf-tur til Hawaii. Heidis uskyldige ekskæreste kommer på besøg, og hun håber, at hans værdier vil smitte af på Spencer.
programme.sub-title: I Always Had A Little Crush

programme.title: The Hills: Playmates Bring the Drama
programme.desc: Audrina bliver knust, da Brodys kæreste konfronterer hende om Hawaii og Brody ikke gør noget for at stoppe det. Heidi opsnapper en sms fra Stacie til Spencer og tager på natklub for at konfrontere hende.

programme.title: The Hills: Keep Your Enemies Closer
programme.desc: Justin konfronterer Audrina om at være sammen med Brody i Hawaii. Stephanie ødelægger en fotooptagelse på jobbet, så Lauren får skældud af Kelly. Bartenderen Stacie prøver at slutte fred med Heidi.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach US: Ex-Viction Notice
programme.desc: Hemmelighedshullet slår til, da Angela bliver sat i den varme stol, og Nurys skal træffe en vigtig beslutning. Ekserne mødes med en overraskende eliminering.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach US: Ex, Lies, and Polygraph Tape
programme.desc: Farrah vender tilbage for at finde ud af, om hun er kommet sig helt over sin eks. Sandheden afsløres, da alle i huset tvinges til at evaluere deres forhold baseret på en løgnedetektortest.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach US: Reunion Part 1
programme.desc: Efter en turbulent sæson genforenes singlerne og ekserne for første gang for at tale om sæsonens største forhold, splittelser og forræderi. De afslører, om de stadig er forelskede eller er gået fra hinanden siden sæsonen sluttede.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach US: Reunion Part 2
programme.desc: Dramaet fortsætter i anden del af Ex on the Beach Reunion, da løgnedetektoren tvinger Morgan til at indrømme sandheden, et nyt forhold afsløres og utroskab afdækkes.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach: Peak of Love: Welcome to the Peak
programme.desc: 10 reality-kendisser tager til et vinterlandskab for at se, om de kan finde deres næste udkårne, men de ved ikke, at deres ekser vil komme stormende som en lavine.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach: Peak of Love: Winter Un-Wonderland
programme.desc: Callum og Nicoles ekser skaber store problemer. En forbindelse bliver skabt og hurtigt brudt igen. En ny eks kommer, og den første hotte date bliver belønnet.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach: Peak of Love: Caught Red Velvet Handed
programme.desc: Daniel gør et akavet forsøg på at skabe en forbindelse. Det går hedt for sig i Hemmelighedssaunaen for en lumsk single. Den første eks bliver frosset ude.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach: Peak of Love: De Niall Is Not Just an Ex
programme.desc: Marlon får opmærksomhed fra flere ekser, og det er Adore ikke glad for. En charmerende overraskelse afbryder den hotte date.
programme.sub-title: De Niall Is Not Just an Ex

programme.title: Ex On The Beach: Peak of Love: Boo Years Eve!
programme.desc: Hemmelighedssaunaen åbenbarer et mysterium for Marlond eks. To singler kæmper om den samme eks. Bølgerne går højt til isceremonien, når en eks foretager et overraskende træk.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach: Peak of Love: The Bird Has Landed
programme.desc: Georgia og Callums forhold bliver sat på prøve, da den eks, de frygtede mest, dukker op. Bølgerne går højt over La Demis seneste flamme. En romantisk hot date bliver belønnet.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach: Peak of Love: SOS, Save Our Singles
programme.desc: En chokerende Hemmelighedssauna betyder, at singlerne må være på vagt ved isceremonien. Allie og Nialls ustabile forhold gør Allie usikker.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach: Peak of Love: Ex-Cuzzi
programme.desc: En perfekt date bliver til et perfekt mareridt for et par. Niall får seriøs konkurrence om Allies følelser. Marion og La Demi har svært ved at hitte ud af deres situation.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach: Peak of Love: Mums the Word
programme.desc: Georgia og Callum møder deres hårdeste kritiker. Marion kommer i klemme, når en eks ankommer, der bringer forholdet til La Demi i fare. Isceremonien tager en uventet drejning.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach: Peak of Love: Don't Say Soulmate
programme.desc: Da en første kærlighed ankommer, får det gyldne par sig en overraskelse. En ny forbindelse og en overraskede beslutning ved den hotte date får Tyranny til at se rødt.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach: The Beach Of Doom
programme.desc: 8 sexede singler håber at finde kærligheden på en paradisstrand. Men der er en twist, for drømmeferien ødelægges, da deres ekskærester dukker op, en after en. Nogle for at få hævn, andre for at få forholdet til at blusse op igen.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach: Mad Frank
programme.desc: Drømmeferien, hvor 8 singler leder efter kærligheden bliver ramt af mere grus i maskineriet. Vicky fortsætter sin affære med Ross. Marcos eks, Frankie, opdager at hun har en rival. Ash og Chloe får sig et chok, da den næste eks dukker op.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach: Don't Hate The Player
programme.desc: Den fjerde ekskæreste ankommer til stranden og skaber problemer for singlerne: Ross føler Chloes vrede, da hans forhold til Vicky udvikler sig. Det går vildt for sig mellem Taitha og Ash og Marco og Frankie når bristepunktet med Emily.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach: Playing With Fire
programme.desc: Den femte ekskæreste ankommer til stranden for at overraske Vicky og Ross. Tingene bliver værre for Talitha og en chokerende afrejse efterlader alle i panik, for hvilken eks bliver nu den næste, som ankommer.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach: Tuletha's Got A Secret
programme.desc: Ash kunne ikke være mere chokeret over ankomsten af den sjette eks på stranden. Emily og Liam er på en date fra helvede, Farah bliver forelsket og Talitha bliver rystet, da en hemmelighed truer med at slippe ud og ødelægge hendes forhold til Ash.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach: The Truth's Out
programme.desc: Ross siger til sin eks Chloe, at han vil prøve igen, og Jack prøver med Emily. Ashs verden forandrer sig, da Joss afslører det hemmelige kys med Talitha, og sevfølgelig dukker der også endnu en eks op på stranden.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach: The Champion Of Exes
programme.desc: Ash og Talitha har kun lige slået op, da han finder sammen med Chloe. Shelby og Ross kommer hinanden nærmere, da de overnatter på en kirkegård. Vickys eks kommer, hvilket hun ikke har glædet sig til, og så går det løs på stranden.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach: Liam's Final Stir Of The Pot
programme.desc: Da Vickys anden eks, Ricci, dukker op, splittes gruppen. Ash flipper ud på Liam med alvorlige konsekvenser. Dan truer med at flippe ud på Ricci, og Ricci og Vicky prøver at få en slags afslutning, men uden succes.
programme.sub-title: Liam's Final Stir Of The Pot

programme.title: Celebrity Ex on the Beach: Love at First Sight
programme.desc: Otte single-kendisser mødes i en luksusvilla. Det slår gnister for Joey. Calum får en overraskelse og Lateysha brænder varm på en bad boy. De første kendisser ankommer, men ender det i tårer?

programme.title: Celebrity Ex on the Beach: Breaking Point
programme.desc: At se Joey og Lorena sammen bliver for meget for Ellie. Latisha bliver efterladt af Michael, men en ny, sexet kendis får hende til at svæve på en sky. Calum og Marisa fortsætter med at flirte.

programme.title: Celebrity Ex on the Beach: Will You Be My Girlfriend?
programme.desc: Calum er fanget mellem to ekser - Marissa og Victoria, der er ny. Marissa er ikke tilfreds. Joey stiller Lorena et stort spørgsmål, og Ashley kommer i vennezonen.

programme.desc: Bølgerne går højt mellem Cam og Kwasi, da Kwasi lægger an på Kayla. Asia eksploderer, da hun tror, at nogle folk i huset er falske. Zak må træffe et valg.

programme.title: Are You The One?: I Want You To Want Me
programme.desc: Nutsa er vild med Brett, men det får konsekvenser for hele huset, at Brett ikke kan glemme Cali. Moe bliver presset til at spille spillet, og Lewis afslører sine sande følelser for Asia.
programme.sub-title: I Want You To Want Me

programme.title: Are You The One?: Master Plan
programme.desc: Brias besættelse af Zak truer husets evne til at spille spillet. Cali finder på en plan, der skal afsløre, hvilke magtpar, der er perfekte sammen, og hvem der ikke er.

programme.title: Are You The One?: Once Upon a Crazy Party Time
programme.desc: Til en vild fest gør tvivlsom opførsel bedste venner til fjender. Tevin og Kenya gør sig klar til at få opklaret deres skæbne. Moe bliver presset til at tage sig sammen.
programme.sub-title: Once Upon a Crazy Party Time

programme.title: Are You The One?: Caught On Kiss Cam
programme.desc: Kwasi og Jasmines forhold bliver bragt i fare, når en velkendt fjende komme lidt for tæt på. Magtpar prøver at skabe nye forbindelser.

programme.title: Are You The One?: This is Nuts-a
programme.desc: Brett kommer i den varme stol, da han tvivler på sine følelser for Nutsa. Huset kommer i krise, da de prøver at hitte ud af de perfekte par.

programme.title: Are You The One?: It All Comes Down To This
programme.desc: Asia forsøger at ødelægge Sams forhold til Daniel. Huset får en sidste chance for at vinde kærlighed og penge og en ekstra dag til at bringe orden i tingene.
programme.sub-title: It All Comes Down To This

programme.title: Are You The One?: Reunion The Final Matchup
programme.desc: Efter at have søgt efter kærlighed i flere uger og spillet for penge, genforenes de medvirkende i sæson 7 for at give insiderviden om eksplosive hændelser og fortælle om uset dramatik og afsløre, hvad der er sket, efter de har forladt huset.

programme.title: Are You The One?: Come One, Come All Part 1
programme.desc: For første gang nogensinde har kærligheden ingen grænser, når 16 singler ankommer til Hawaii for at finde kærligheden og vinde 1 million dollars.

programme.title: Are You The One?: Come One, Come All Part 2
programme.desc: Der er problemer i paradis for de stærkeste par. Et par kæmper med konceptet åbent forhold. Kærlighedstrekanter bliver rekonfigureret.

programme.title: Are You The One?: This is Trash
programme.desc: Justin er fanget mellem en, der vil have ham og en der ikke ved, hvad de vil have. Basit kæmper for at blive accepteret. Huset skal forholde sig til nogle svære sandheder.

programme.title: Are You The One?: We Come to Slay
programme.desc: Efter queer-prom er huset et figurativt og bogstaveligt rod. Det er forbi for to par. Dionne Slay ankommer.

programme.title: Are You The One?: There Was A Fivesome?
programme.desc: En femkant får dynamikken i huset til at smuldre. Justins selvdestruktive tendenser truer hans forhold til Max. Danny skaber kontakt.

programme.title: Are You The One?: Hate to Burst Your Bubble
programme.desc: Huset vil finde ud af, hvilke af parrene er et perfekt match. Jonathan vil knalde en kærlighedsboble. Kai stiller sig foran Jenna.

programme.title: Are You The One?: Red Flag Alert
programme.desc: Jonathan forsøger at gøre det godt igen med Basit. Et par kommer tættere på hinanden mens andre forsøger at ændre på deres giftige datingadfærd.

programme.title: Are You The One?: This Sucks and Blows
programme.desc: Venner og familie sætter fut i huset. Jenna forsøger at navigere strategi i forhold til hjerte. En tur i bolleværelset har eksplosive konsekvenser.

programme.title: Are You The One?: Games Players Play
programme.desc: De andre i huset må samle stykkerne op da Kais opførsel lægger alt i ruiner. Remy forsøger at lægge sin player-fortid bag sig for at overbevise Paige.

programme.title: Are You The One?: It All Comes Down to Jax
programme.desc: Tre par finder ud af, at de er et perfekt match og to par får en dårlig nyhed. Justin og Max får svar. Paige har svært ved at sænke paraderne.
programme.sub-title: It All Comes Down to Jax

programme.title: Are You The One?: On to the Next
programme.desc: De sidste tre par skal vælges, og en person ved, hvem deres match er. De nye perfekte match lærer hinanden bedre at kende.

programme.title: Are You The One?: All or Nothing
programme.desc: De har kun en chance tilbage for at vinde, og ikke flere kort på hånden, så alle må stole på, at de seks følger deres hjerte og vælger deres perfekte match. Amber er fanget mellem tre mulige partnere.

programme.title: MTV Teen Mom
programme.desc: Oplev de dramatiske øjeblikke, når de unge mødre tackler hverdagens udfordringer eller oplever uforglemmelige øjeblikke. Det er non-stop drama hele dagen, hver dag.

programme.title: Awkward: Knocker Nightmare
programme.desc: Sadie og Lissa sms'er et nøgenfoto af Jenna i pigernes omklædningsrum til hele skolen. Ud over latterliggørelse og sladder får spøgen nogle overraskende reaktioner fra Jennas store forelskelse Matty.

programme.title: Awkward: The Way We Weren't
programme.desc: Jenna undrer sig over, om Matt vil stå frem med deres forhold, da han inviterer hende til en fest. Jenna indser også, at hun måske har mere til fælles med Jake.

programme.title: Awkward: The Scarlet Eye
programme.desc: Jenna vil definere sit forhold til Matty, men er bekymret for, at hun risikerer at miste ham. Imens nyder Tamara sin første sexskandale efter hun fik øjenbetændelse i en heftig omgang i et boblebad.

programme.title: Awkward: Jenna Lives
programme.desc: En mærkelig stalker puster liv i Jennas selvmordshistorie. Jenna undrer sig over, om hendes omdømme afholder Matty fra at se hende som kærestemateriale.

programme.title: Awkward: Queen Bee-atches
programme.desc: Jenna omgås de lede piger, da hun hjælper med Palos Verdes' elite mor/datter velgørende organisation. Det bliver mere akavet, da hun støder ind i Matty og Jake.

programme.title: Awkward: Over My Dead Body
programme.desc: Jenna får rollen som offer i en event om spirituskørsel. Hun kæmper med rollen, mens Jake og Matty kæmper om hendes opmærksomhed.

programme.title: Awkward: The Adventures of Aunt Ally and the Lil' Bitch
programme.desc: Da Laceys BFF Ally kommer til byen beslutter de at 'hjælpe' Jenna med at drikke sig stiv. Næste dag har en glemsom Jenna tømmermænd og kæmper med at huske den vilde aften og hvem hun kyssede.
programme.sub-title: The Adventures of Aunt Ally and the Lil' Bitch

programme.title: Awkward: My Super Bittersweet Sixteen
programme.desc: Jenna får en pinlig 16-års fødselsdag og må håndtere følgerne af alle dem, hun har skubbet væk. Efter hun dumper køreprøven, undrer hun sig over, om hun kan reparere forholdet til Matty og Tamara.

programme.title: Awkward: No Doubt
programme.desc: Matty inviterer Jenna ud på deres første rigtige date. Men en afsløring får Jenna til at tvivle på alt ved sin romance med Matty.

programme.title: Awkward: I Am Jenna Hamilton
programme.desc: Romantik er i luften, og alle er begejstrede for Winter Formal. Selvom Jenna længes efter den store spørger, forsøger hun ikke at lade Matty's afslappede holdning skuffe hende.

programme.title: Awkward: Fateful
programme.desc: Jenna må endelig bestemme sig mellem Jake og Matty. Tamaras kærlighedsliv tager en overraskende drejning. Ming bringer en uventet date, og mysteriet bag pleje-frontation-brevet afsløres.

programme.title: Awkward: Resolutions
programme.desc: Jenna undgår at beskæftige sig med afsløringen af, at hendes mor skrev konfrontationsbrevet. I stedet spreder hun julehumør og nytårsstemning, indtil Jakes gave tvinger hende til at beslutte, om hun er klar til at glemme Matty helt.

programme.title: Awkward: Sex, Lies and the Sanctuary
programme.desc: Jenna nyder, at forholdet med Jake endelig er blevet officielt, indtil hun hører om de seneste måneders skjulte kameraoptagelser fra Sanctuary. Hun går derefter ekstremt til værks - og hverver bl.a. Ming - for ødelægge båndet.

programme.title: Awkward: Three's a Crowd
programme.desc: Jenna prøver at slutte fred med Matty og behage Jake, men har svært ved at ignorere Mattys evindelige flirten og klæbrige opførsel. Hans handlinger får hende til at stille spørgsmålstegn ved, hvem der egentligt er problemet i trioen.

programme.title: Awkward: Are You There God? It's Me, Jenna
programme.desc: Jenna er stadig ikke kommet sig over sine forældres separation og føler sig ansvarlig. I et impulsivt forsøg på at tilgive sig selv søger hun tilflugt fra sine problemer hos de højere magter i den religiøse lejrskole.
programme.sub-title: Are You There God? It's Me, Jenna

programme.title: Awkward: My Love is a Black Heart
programme.desc: Jenna forbereder sig på sin første Valentinsdag med en kæreste, men både hun og Tamara bliver jaloux, da det går op for dem, at deres ekskærester måske er ved at være klar til at komme videre med deres liv og glemme dem.
programme.sub-title: My Love is a Black Heart

programme.title: Awkward: What Comes First: Sex or Love?
programme.desc: Jenna har stadig ikke genfundet sit fodfæste efter Jakes kærlighedserklæring, og hun overvejer, om det at have sex med ham vil give hende klarhed om sine egne følelser.
programme.sub-title: What Comes First: Sex or Love?

programme.title: Awkward: Another one Bites the Dust
programme.desc: Jenna er klar til at have sex med Jake efter endelig at have fået klarhed over sine følelser. Hendes beslutsomhed bliver imidlertid grundigt testet af tante Allys bryllup, en mand fra hendes mors fortid og en intrigant Sadie.

programme.title: Awkward: Time After Time
programme.desc: Dårlig timing og afsløringer efterlader både Jenna og Jake knuste.

programme.title: Awkward: Homewrecker Hamilton
programme.desc: Jenna har svært ved at rede trådene ud i sit forskruede kærlighedsliv efter brud og genforeninger med drengene - lige indtil en uventet tekst placerer hendes dramatiske liv lige midt i rampelyset.

programme.title: Awkward: Pick Me, Choose Me, Love Me
programme.desc: Efter Jennas udgivelse af sin blog har alle pludselig en mening om hendes liv. Mens alle andre følger med for underholdningens skyld, kræver Jake og Matty svar.
programme.sub-title: Pick Me, Choose Me, Love Me

programme.title: Awkward: Once Upon a Blog
programme.desc: Jennas fantasi løber af med hende, og hun omdanner sin blog til en fiktiv fortælling i et forsøg på at ændre sin skæbne. Ved at undersøge og forestille sig en anden udgave af sin fortid forsøger Jenna at gennemskue fremtiden.

programme.title: Awkward: The Other Shoe
programme.desc: Jennas beslutning om drengene når ud til alle. Læg dertil en tur til Europa, og alt ser ud til at gå godt for Jenna. Der sker imidlertid noget, der får Jenna til at betvivle, om det at få alt det, hun ønsker, er det, hun har brug for.

programme.title: Awkward: Cha-Cha-Cha-Changes
programme.desc: Tredje år på high school byder på overraskelser og forandringer, der kan ændre hele Jennas fremtid.

programme.title: Awkward: Responsibly Irresponsible
programme.desc: En klassekammerats død får Jenna til at tænke over tab og sorg, og hun tager ansvar for den hemmelighed, hun skjuler fra Matty.

programme.title: Awkward: A Little Less Conversation
programme.desc: Matty virker fjern, da han hører, at Jenna tror, hun er gravid, men Jenna vil næsten gøre alt for ikke at tage 'snakken'.

programme.title: Awkward: Let's Talk About Sex
programme.desc: Jennas far gør selv noget ved sagen og taler med Mattys forældre om deres børns forhold.

programme.title: Awkward: Indecent Exposure
programme.desc: Da Matty flytter ind hos Hamiltons indser Jenna, at hun har fået mere med i købet end hun havde håbet på.

programme.title: Awkward: That Girl Strikes Again
programme.desc: Spøgelserne fra Jennas fortid, og Jennas egen usikkerhed, melder sig på banen da det bliver Halloween i Palos Hills.

programme.title: Awkward: Guilt Trippin'
programme.desc: Jenna's første date til Homecoming-festen vækker skyldige minder om den pige, hun plejede at være og om de piger, der ikke har en date.

programme.title: Awkward: Rubbed Raw and Reeling
programme.desc: En udfordring fra Mr. Hart tvinger Jenna til at blotte sig selv se nogle svære afsløringer om sig selv i øjnene.

programme.title: Awkward: Reality Check
programme.desc: Efter at have taget en kop kaffe med Collin en sen aften kan Jenna ikke holde op med at tænke på ham og på, hvad det vil sige både at være småforelsket og at have en kæreste.

programme.title: Awkward: Redefining Jenna
programme.desc: Gnidningerne vokser mellem Jenna og Matty, da Collin inviterer hende til en smart fotografi-udstilling hjemme hos ham.

programme.title: Awkward: Surprise!
programme.desc: Efter at have været sammen med Collin beslutter Jenna sig for at holde op med at være utro før Matty finder ud af det.

programme.title: Awkward: And Then What Happened
programme.desc: Hvad skete der til surprisefesten - og er det virkelig helt slut mellem Jenna og Matty? Det ved kun de to, men deres venner forsøger at finde ud af sandheden.

programme.title: Awkward: Taking Sides
programme.desc: Jenna holder grillfest så hendes venner kan vænne sig til tanken om hendes og Collins spirende forhold. Men da deres støtte udebliver, tager hun drastiske midler i brug.

programme.title: Awkward: The Bad Seed
programme.desc: Efter at være blevet uvenner med Tamara og Ming, synes Jenna ikke at det spiller nogen rolle hvad hun gør længere - og det kaster hende ud i en vanskelig situation.

programme.title: Awkward: A Very Special Episode of Awkward
programme.desc: Val beder Mr Harts klasse om at skrive og fremføre et skuespil, og moralen i historien virker bekendt.
programme.sub-title: A Very Special Episode of Awkward

programme.title: Awkward: Less Than Hero
programme.desc: Efterdønningerne etter Jennas skænderi med vennerne får hende til at gå i byen. Men det som skulle blive en afslappende aften bliver en aften, hun skal reddes fra.

programme.title: Awkward: The Campaign Fail
programme.desc: Det er på tide for Jenna at komme på ret spor igen, men hun har forårsaget mere skade for sine nærmeste en hun kan rette op med med lidt PR. Vil de tilgive hende, eller må hun tage drastiske midler brug?

programme.title: Awkward: Old Jenna
programme.desc: Jenna og pigerne er gode venner igen og Jenna mener, at hun er klar til at genoptage forholdet til Matty.

programme.title: Revolutionary Road
programme.desc: Baseret på Richard Yates' bestseller følger denne fængslende og gribende historie om et lidenskabeligt, ungt par i forstads-Connecticut, som bestemmer sig for at risikere alt og følge deres drømme.

programme.title: Annihilation
programme.desc: Biologen og den tidligere soldat Lena (Natalie Portman) må lede en mission til en mystisk karantænezone kendt som "The Shimmer", en smuk, men livsfarlig verden af muterede landskaber og dyr, som truer alt liv på Jorden. Oscar Isaac spiller også med.

programme.title: Brothers
programme.desc: Da en dekoreret marinesoldat forsvinder i udlandet, begynder hans lillebror, familiens sorte får, at tage sig af hans kone og børn derhjemme - med konsekvenser, der vil ryste hele familiens fundament.

programme.title: The Yards
programme.desc: Leo Handler (Mark Wahlberg) løslades fra fængsel og tager et job hos sin indflydelsesrige onkel Frank (James Caan). Snart trækkes Leo uforvarende ind i en verden af sabotage, store bestikkelser og endda mord.

programme.title: Humor Me
programme.desc: Humor Me er en hjertevarm komedie om en kriseramt skuespilforfatter, som er tvunget til at flytte ind hos sin vittige far i et pensionistsamfund i New Jersey og lærer, som hans far ofte siger, at ”livet finder sted, om man smiler eller ej”.

programme.title: Patrick
programme.desc: Sarah Francis er en ung kvinde, hvis liv er noget værre rod. Det sidste, hun har brug for, er en anden, hun skal tage sig af. Men uanset om hun kan lide det eller ej, har hendes bedstemor ladet sin meget forkælede hund, mopsen Patrick, gå i arv til hende.

programme.title: Demain tout commence
programme.desc: Samuel nyder et sorgløst liv på Den Franske Riviera, indtil Kristin, som han har haft en kortvarig affære med, meddeler, at han er far til et nyfødt barn, overlader en lille pige til ham og stikker af!

programme.title: John Grisham's The Rainmaker

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender: The Drill
programme.desc: Aang discovers a secret Fire Nation super weapon heading straight for Ba Sing Se and must stop it before it destroys the great wall that protects the city from invasion.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender: City of Walls and Secrets
programme.desc: Aang and the kids finally arrive in Ba Sing Se to see the Earth King, only to find mysterious forces within the city conspiring to stop them. Meanwhile, Jet tries to find proof that Zuko and Uncle are Fire Nation.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender: Tales of Ba Sing Se
programme.desc: A series of short stories, highlighting different characters and their individual adventures in the city. Tales of Katara and Toph, Uncle, Sokka, Aang, Zuko, and Momo.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender: Appa's Lost Days
programme.desc: In this special episode, we go back in time to the moment Appa was stolen, and find out exactly what happened to him, and where's he's been all this time - and where he is now!

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender: Lake Laogai
programme.desc: While searching for Appa, the kids run into Jet, but are torn about whether to trust him or not. Meanwhile, Zuko also hunts for Appa.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender: The Earth King
programme.desc: The kids battle Long Feng the Dai Li when they attempt to show the Earth King the vast conspiracy taking place in his city. Zuko becomes seriously ill and has feverish dreams as he faces a spiritual crisis.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender: The Guru
programme.desc: Aang starts to learn control of the Avatar State from Guru Pathik at the Eastern Air Temple. Sokka is reunited with his father.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender: The Crossroads of Destiny
programme.desc: When Aang has a vision that Katara is in danger, Aang, Sokka, and Toph all rush back to Ba Sing Se to save her. They meet up with Iroh, who asks their help in saving Zuko who had been captured as well.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender: The Awakening
programme.desc: After sustaining serious injuries at the end of season two, Aang awakens to find himself aboard a Fire Nation ship. Meanwhile, Zuko journeys home.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender: The Headband
programme.desc: Mistaken for a Fire Nation School student, the disguised Aang is forced to enroll in a Fire nation school. Aang's hair helped to disguise him better with his head band.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender: The Painted Lady
programme.desc: When the gang comes to a suffering fishing village, a mysterious spirit appears to help the villagers.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender: Sokka's Master
programme.desc: When Sokka feels he's not contributing enough to the group, he seeks out a mysterious master to teach him the ways of the sword.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender: The Beach
programme.desc: Zuko, Azula, Mai, and Ty Lee go on vacation to Lo and Li's beach house, where they learn much about themselves and each other.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender: The Avatar and The Firelord
programme.desc: Aang and Zuko are taken on parallel adventures that give them insight into their forefathers' pasts - but how does the tale of Roku and Sozin matter to them now?

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender: The Runaway
programme.desc: When Toph discovers a quick way to make cash, Katara disapproves, and the rift between them has disastrous consequences.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender: The Puppetmaster
programme.desc: In a Halloween installment, the gang looks into strange disappearances in a spooky town. There, an old lady named Hama teaches Katara some secret Waterbending techniques.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender: Nightmares and Daydreams
programme.desc: On the eve of the eclipse, Aang's anxiety gets the better of him. His dreams become nightmares, and soon he can no longer tell dream from reality.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender: The Day of Black Sun Part 1: The Invasion
programme.desc: It is the Day of Black Sun and the group meets up with the invasion force."The day has finally arrived and Aang is ready to take on the Fire Lord.
programme.sub-title: The Day of Black Sun Part 1: The Invasion

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender: The Day of Black Sun Part 2: The Eclipse
programme.desc: The eclipse has started and the gang only has a few minutes to get into an underground bunker and find and defeat Ozai.
programme.sub-title: The Day of Black Sun Part 2: The Eclipse

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender: The Western Air Temple
programme.desc: The gang leaves the Fire Nation, humbled and embarrassed by the failure of the invasion. They head to the Western Air Temple.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender: The Firebending Masters
programme.desc: Aang is ready to start his firebending training. However, as Zuko attempts to teach him, he realizes he has lost all his firebending power.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender: The Boiling Rock Part 1
programme.desc: Sokka and Zuko break into The Boiling Rock Prison, the Fire Nation's highest security prison, to rescue Hakoda. When they develope an escape plan after finding Hakoda not there, other prisoners get involved and ruin it.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender: The Boiling Rock Part 2
programme.desc: This episode is continuing the jailbreak from the previous episode. Sokka, Hakoda, Zuko and Suki form a new escape plan, but it is complicated by the arrival of Princess Azula.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender: The Southern Raiders
programme.desc: Katara and Zuko journey together to find the man responsible for the death of Katara's mother, Kya, who was killed in a Southern Water Tribe raid.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender: The Ember Island Players
programme.desc: The gang goes to the theater to see a play about themselves, but are not happy with the production and the inaccurate portrayals of themselves.

programme.title: The Legend of Korra: Welcome to Republic City

programme.title: The Legend of Korra: A Leaf in the Wind
programme.desc: After hitting a snag in her airbending training with Master Tenzin, Korra pays a visit to the city's Pro Bending arena in search of inspiration.

programme.title: The Legend of Korra: The Revelation
